plausible: Exact plausible.io/api/event only. Self-hosted/proxied hosts and adjacent paths remain uncontracted. Bare JSON retains its existing name, URL and domain shape discriminator.

New parser-profile checks are advisory and pinned to public source. Native m, meta, p, props maps use source precedence. JSON-encoded property values and the encoded short revenue alias remain accepted representations with their inner contents unverified.

ISO 4217 currency advice uses the dated built-in current registry. It does not certify the deployed CLDR currency universe, plan entitlement, configured goals, FX conversion or receiver acceptance. Invalid revenue can be discarded while the event is recorded.
Signed and exponent amounts and JSON-encoded long revenue are retained. Decimal prefix parsing, nonfinite values and the full Money/Decimal acceptance universe are not replicated.

Engagement sd and e advice applies only to the selected engagement event. Scroll values above100 are accepted and clamped by the source. Zero time alone, missing metrics, integer grammar and the30day time ceiling are checked. Full JSON numeric-token versus Elixir integer semantics are not certified.

Native property scalar values receive the pinned2000UTF8byte advice. Property key lengths retain character advice; the source key-byte budget and its full filtering/retention order remain incomplete. Empty referrers are accepted; long referrers receive truncation advice.

Docs describe a2000character URL path limit while the pinned parser also has a full raw URL byte guard. That source discrepancy remains explicit. Domain inference from URL, alias false/null handling outside the new property/revenue profiles, special system event behavior, replay headers, bot filtering and actual delivery need further context or source-scoped work.
amplitude-group-identify: Exact /groupidentify on api2.amplitude.com and api.eu.amplitude.com only. Other hosts, including the analytics UI, remain uncontracted rather than inheriting the full amplitude.com suffix.

Each supported operation map is bounded at1024properties, a necessary consequence of the published request budget. This does not enforce the aggregate across operations or rows; multiple individually small maps can still exceed the total.

The published1MB request size does not resolve byte units or serialized accounting. No guessed limit is introduced. Group/account configuration, credential validity, rate limits, future-event attribution and receiver acceptance remain external.

review_notes: Golden expectations were authored from primary documentation and pinned parser branches. No production SDK or receiver execution is claimed.
Negative/exponent revenue, encoded long revenue, empty referrers, short-key precedence and clamped scroll depth have explicit valid controls.
Existing revenue pair finding codes are retained. No shared engine behavior changes.
Low parameter counts alone are not defects. No unpublished ID grammar, exhaustive future enum or account-specific mandatory field is invented.
